full_judgment: 2. Opposite party as plaintiffs instituted the suit for recovery of khas possession by evicting the defendant stating, inter alia, that the, property belonged to the plaintiff and that the defendant was inducted as a tenant in the suit premises and that the defendant did not pay the rents regularly and thus became defaulter and that the plaintiffs therefore sent notice under section 106 of the Transfer of Property Act which was received by the defendant and in spite of receiving, the notice the defendant did not vacate the suit premises and hence was the suit.
